attributes.board_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health (Connecticut Medical Examining Board)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses offered or approved by AMA, AOA, Connecticut Hospital Association, Connecticut State Medical Society, Connecticut Osteopathic Medical Society, county medical societies or equivalents elsewhere; hospital/health care institution offerings; regionally accredited academic institutions; state or local health departments. Contact hour = at least 50 minutes
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first license renewal.
rules.alternatives: Exemption for licensees not in active practice (notarized application; 25 hours or FSMB SPEX to return) and waiver/extension for medical disability or illness. Up to 10 hours may be waived for Medical Examining Board service and similar activities.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; do not mail certificates unless directed. Keep records 6 years; submit within 45 days of a Department request.

topics.who: Infectious diseases incl. HIV/AIDS; first renewal period with CME, then at least once every 6 years
Risk management incl. prescribing controlled substances and pain management, screening for inflammatory breast and GI cancers (endometriosis optional); first CME renewal, then every 6 years
Incl. systemic racism, explicit and implicit bias, racial disparities, transgender and gender diverse patients

rules.notes: License renewed annually (one-year registration period); CME counted over the preceding 24 months. Also 1 hour each every 6 years in sexual assault and behavioral health (may include 2 h on suicide prevention, cognitive conditions or veterans' mental health) - no topic codes.
